rules.text: A run has exactly 3 acts. Act index 0 = Overgrowth *or* Underdocks, 1 = Hive, 2 = Glory. DeprecatedAct has index -1 and is never used. "Act 1-4" in third-party simulators counts four act *models*, not four acts.
rules.evidence: E1 Models.Acts/{Overgrowth,Underdocks,Hive,Glory,DeprecatedAct}.cs (Index), Models/ActModel.cs GetRandomList, Models/ModelDb.cs ActsByIndex; E3

rules.text: After the last act's boss, the game enters the scripted TheArchitect event room; when it completes (IsVictoryRoom) WinRun() ends the run as a victory. The event contains no player-damaging logic, so *win = clear the final act (both bosses at A10)*. There is no Heart, no keys, no Act 4.
Underdocks (alternate Act 1) must be unlocked; in single player an undiscovered non-default act takes priority, then the game rolls between available acts.
Double Boss (A10): the last act additionally gets a second, different boss chosen at run start from that act's other boss encounters (up-front RNG - hidden until shown).

Act map: 7 columns; 17/17/16/15 floors (Overgrowth/Underdocks/Hive/Glory) in solo, one fewer room in co-op; 3 merchants; 5 elites (8 with A1); first room is a fight; elites/rests never in first five rooms; a rest site always precedes the boss.

Enum: 0 None, 1 SwarmingElites, 2 WearyTraveler, 3 Poverty, 4 TightBelt, 5 AscendersBane, 6 Inflation, 7 Scarcity, 8 ToughEnemies, 9 DeadlyEnemies, 10 DoubleBoss. Max = 10 (maxAscensionAllowed). HasLevel(x) = level >= x. There is no A11-A20.
A3 Poverty: encounter gold min/max = (int)(base * 0.75) (truncating): monster 7-15, elite 26-33, boss 75 (base 10-20 / 35-45 / 100).
A4 Tight Belt: -1 potion slot. A5: Ascender's Bane added to the starting deck (floor 1).
A6 Inflation: card removal costs 100 + 50*n instead of 75 + 25*n (n = removals used). (Older "Gloom: fewer rest sites" text is stale.)
A7 Scarcity: see CARD-3..CARD-6 and UPG-1.
A2 Weary Traveler (Ancients heal 80% of missing HP), A1 (+3 elites), A8/A9 (enemy HP / damage)

Rarity roll with offset o: draw r ~ U[0,1); T_rare = baseRare + o (not clamped); rare if r < T_rare; uncommon if r < baseUncommon + T_rare; else common. Hence P(rare)=clamp(baseRare+o,0,1) and the uncommon/common boundary shifts with the offset (regular fight at the -5 start: 0 / 35 / 65 %, not 0 / 37 / 63 %).
Base odds (rare / uncommon): regular 3% / 37%, elite 10% / 40%, shop 9% / 37%, boss 100% rare (offset ignored in the roll).
A7 base rare: regular 1.49% (not 1.5), elite 5%, shop 4.5%; uncommon unchanged.

After each card of an Encounter-sourced reward whose odds type is Regular/Elite/Boss: rare -> offset = -0.05; non-rare -> offset = min(offset + growth, 0.40). Cards in a pack are rolled sequentially, so later cards see earlier results; cards after a rare in the *same* pack restart from -0.05.
Boss rewards also reset the counter (Roll(BossEncounter) returns Rare -> offset = -0.05) even though the roll ignores the offset. (sts.wiki only says "offset ignored".)

Shop cards read the offset without advancing it (RollWithoutChangingFutureOdds(Shop)); non-encounter sources (events, relic packs such as Orrery) use RollWithBaseOdds: rare if r < baseRare, uncommon if r < baseUncommon (not cumulative) -> 3 / 34 / 63 % at A0 regular odds. Neither advances the counter.

If no eligible card exists at the rolled rarity, the roll steps to the next-higher rarity with wrapping (GetNextAllowedRarity). A card is then drawn uniformly from the eligible cards of that rarity not already in the pack.

Derived published checks that my model reproduces exactly: offset table (28 cells incl. A7), "1+ rare right after a rare": regular 0 %, elite 16.95 %; stationary run averages regular 19.72 % / elite 30.91 %.
Per-player odds sets (co-op: each seat has its own counters).

After each pack card: r ~ U[0,1); if the card is upgradable: odds = actIndex * scaling for non-rare cards (scaling = 0.25, A7 0.125), 0 for rares; upgrade if r <= odds. => Act 1: 0 %, Act 2: 25 % (12.5 % A7), Act 3: 50 % (25 % A7). Shop cards never upgrade (base -999999999). Relics/events may modify via hooks (not modelled).
Stored chance c starts 0.40. After each eligible fight: threshold = c + (Elite ? 0.25*0.5 = 0.125 : 0); r ~ U[0,1); if forced
Forced drops (Hook.ShouldForcePotionReward, e.g. White Beast Statue) also decrement c in v0.107.1. Beta v0.108.0 changed this ("no longer decreases your normal potion odds"). Pin per build.
Dropped potion rarity: r<=0.10 rare, r<=0.35 uncommon, else common => 10 / 25 / 65 %.
v0.107.1 fixed a bug where the follow-up potion odds could rise instead of fall after an elite potion reward. Data from builds before 0.107.1 is not comparable.

Counters start at base: fight 0.10, elite -1 (disabled), treasure 0.02, shop 0.03. One roll r ~ U[0,1]; scan fight -> (elite) -> treasure -> shop accumulating only positive counters; the first with r <= cumulative wins; otherwise event (1 - sum of positive counters).

After each roll the rolled type resets to its base; every other enabled type gains +base (hook-modifiable). Counters reset to base between acts (ResetToBase). The marginal event/fight/shop/treasure mix for the n-th "?" of an act: 85/10/3/2, 71.13/19/5.91/3.96, 60.34/25.30/8.56/5.80, 53.47/28.27/10.80/7.46, 49.94/28.62/12.56/8.88, 48.35/27.83/13.80/10.03 %.
A profile's very first run is scripted: first two "?" rooms are events, the third is a monster fight.
Not modelled: the room-type *blacklist* supplied by callers and relic hooks (ModifyUnknownMapPointRoomTypes, ModifyOddsIncreaseForUnrolledRoomType).

Stock: 5 character cards of types [Attack, Attack, Skill, Skill, Power] (rarity rolled per slot via shop odds, fallback by card type), one uniformly random character slot on sale; 2 colorless cards (one Uncommon, one Rare); 3 relics (two rarity-rolled 50/33/17 % common/uncommon/rare, one "Shop"-rarity); 3 potions; one card-removal service.
Card price = round(base * U[0.95,1.05]); base common 50 / uncommon 75 / rare 150; colorless base x1.15 rounded (86 / 173); on sale: integer /2.
Relic price = round(MerchantCost * U[0.85,1.15]); MerchantCost: common 175, uncommon 225, rare 275, shop 200. Potion price = round(base * U[0.95,1.05]), base common 50 / uncommon 75 / rare 100.
Card removal cost = Base + Increase * removalsUsed; A0: 75 + 25n; A6+: 100 + 50n.
Final price may be modified by relic hooks (ModifyMerchantPrice); not modelled.
Combat gold = uniform integer in [min, max]: monster 10-20, elite 35-45, boss 100 (Poverty: see ASC-2); scaled by the room's GoldProportion in special encounters (e.g. escaped Gremlins).

Drawing n cards without replacement from N with K targets: P(>=1)=1-C(N-K,n)/C(N,n); full PMF is hypergeometric. Valid only for a uniformly shuffled draw pile with no reshuffle during the draw; retain/ethereal/exhaust/innate/discard/orbs/shuffle-triggers invalidate it (the UI must say so).

Main v0.107.1 (2026-06-18 "Major Update #2"), Steam build 23811903. Beta v0.111.0 (2026-08-13), build id 24724944 (2026-08-14 update). Newest announcement at retrieval: Neowsletter 2026-09-25 ("can't give a specific timeline ... for the next patch").
v0.107.1 replaced the PRNG (xoshiro256): seeds from earlier builds do not reproduce; seeds must never be compared across builds.

Beta v0.108-v0.111 changed several card rarities (e.g. Echoing Slash, Bloodletting, Cruelty, Dominate, Accelerant, Flanking, Ignition) and White Beast Statue's potion interaction. Pools and odds are therefore build-specific.
Act-3 boss Doormaker was removed and replaced by Aeonglass (main v0.107.1).

rules.text: Relics that change card packs (Prayer Wheel: second regular pack after fights; White Star: all-rare pack after elites; Lasting Candy; Driftwood: reroll; Pael's Wing: sacrifice; Orrery: five packs from base odds; Dingy Rug/Prismatic Gem: pool changes; Molten Egg/Silver Crucible/Lava Lamp: upgrades) are not modelled; the advisor must say "relic X changes this" instead of silently using base rules.
Merchant relics from treasure rolls are common 50 % / uncommon 33 % / rare 17 %; elite relics use the same split.
